: Synthetic Better Lyrics stream with INVENTED lyrics: the shape of what
: POST https://lyrics.api.dacubeking.com/v2/lyrics returns (text/event-stream).
: Blocks are separated by a blank line. In a block, "event:" names the event and the
: values of the "data:" lines, joined, are one JSON value. Lines starting with ":" are
: SSE comments, added here for readers; Better Lyrics and parseSse() ignore them.
: Order: metadata, one "provider" block per provider that answered, done.

: metadata: the song as the API resolved it. BL reads song, artist, album, duration (s).
event: metadata
data: {"song":"Northbound Kites","artist":"Marrow & Tin","album":"Weather Almanac","duration":72}

: lrclib: results.synced is LRC (line-synced), results.plain is plain text.
event: provider
data: {"provider":"lrclib","results":{"synced":"[00:12.25] Paper lanterns on the water\n[00:17.10] Half-remembered names we wrote\n[00:22.30] A thousand little fires (oh)\n[00:28.05] Drifting where the river goes\n[00:58.40] Carry me home (carry me home)","plain":"Paper lanterns on the water\nHalf-remembered names we wrote\nA thousand little fires (oh)\nDrifting where the river goes\n\nCarry me home (carry me home)"}}

: musixmatch: results.wordByWord is LRC with <mm:ss.xx> word tags (spaces are timed
: as whitespace-only segments; "Half-" + "remembered" is one word; [bg: ...] is a
: backing vocal), results.synced is line-synced LRC.
event: provider

: qq: results.lyrics is a JSON string whose .lyrics is QRC XML; the lyrics are in the
: LyricContent attribute: [start,duration] per line, then text(start,duration) per piece (ms).
event: provider
data: {"provider":"qq","results":{"lyrics":"{\"lyrics\":\"<?xml version=\\\"1.0\\\" encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\"?>\\n<QrcInfos>\\n<QrcHeadInfo SaveTime=\\\"1759622400\\\" Version=\\\"100\\\"/>\\n<LyricInfo LyricCount=\\\"1\\\">\\n<Lyric_1 LyricType=\\\"1\\\" LyricContent=\\\"[ti:Northbound Kites]\\n[ar:Marrow &amp; Tin]\\n[al:Weather Almanac]\\n[by:]\\n[offset:0]\\n[0,3000]Northbound (0,500)Kites (500,500)- (1000,500)Marrow (1500,500)&amp; (2000,500)Tin(2500,500)\\n[3000,2000]Written (3000,500)by：(3500,500)Ada (4000,500)Invented(4500,500)\\n[12250,2770]Paper (12250,390)lanterns (12700,680)on (13450,170)the (13660,120)water(13840,1180)\\n[17100,3140]Half-(17100,320)remembered (17420,730)names (18230,470)we (18760,170)wrote(19000,1240)\\n[22300,3600]A (22300,150)thou(22520,280)sand (22800,320)little (23200,410)fires (23700,780)(oh)(24700,1200)\\n[28050,3150]Drifting (28050,510)where (28640,260)the (28940,110)river (29120,480)goes(29680,1520)\\n[58400,4000]Carry (58400,550)me (59050,350)home (59500,600)(carry (60100,450)me (60600,250)home)(60900,1500)\\n\\\"/>\\n</LyricInfo>\\n</QrcInfos>\"}"}}
